title: 1.3.16 Split the Reused Variable
description: One variable doing four jobs. Give each job its own well-named variable. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Split the four purposes apart
steps.instructions: The variable `stuff` is used for four unrelated things. Declare four separate variables instead: maxScore, playerName, isGameOver and levelCount.

steps.title: Keep the output the same
steps.instructions: Log all four values, so the program still prints the same four lines in the same order.

steps.title: Remove `stuff` entirely
steps.instructions: No variable named stuff should remain anywhere in the file.

requirements.title: maxScore holds the number
requirements.description: Declares maxScore with a numeric value

requirements.title: isGameOver holds a boolean
requirements.description: isGameOver holds a boolean -- true, false, or a comparison that produces one (lesson 1.2.18) -- not quoted text and not a number

requirements.title: levelCount holds the number
requirements.description: Declares levelCount with a numeric value

requirements.title: All four are printed
requirements.description: Logs each of the four new variables

requirements.title: stuff is gone
requirements.description: The reused variable no longer appears anywhere in the file
